The smaller text blocks (subtitle and speech/caption boxes) contain nonsensical, alien-like symbols rather than readable language. Several characters have malformed hands. The figure on the left has fingers that merge into the body or objects they hold. The central figure's arms show awkward joint connections and unclear anatomy.
There is slight bleeding between the character outlines and the yellow background. The texture of the 'paper' looks uniformly digital rather than having the subtle grain of scanned print media.
The characters in the lower right appear to merge into each other, with unclear boundaries between their clothing and bodies.
